title: ottleya nivea
intro: Ottleya nivea, commonly known as White Desert Rose or Desert Rose, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It is native to the deserts of the southwestern United States, Mexico, and the northern parts of the Baja California Peninsula. The health benefits of Ottleya nivea include its potential to treat fever, cough, and sore throat due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties.
